findings.description: The KMS key does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so automatic annual rotation of the key material is disabled by default, increasing the risk associated with long-lived key material if it is ever compromised.

findings.issue_category: missing key policy / overly permissive default access
findings.description: No key_policy is defined for this KMS key, meaning it relies on the default AWS-managed policy that grants full access (kms:*) to the root account, which can allow any IAM principal with IAM permissions in the account to use or manage the key, weakening access control over encryption of the audit trail bucket.
